programmes.d: Inaban is not well, and she has been hiding it from the group; Taichi feels her physical pain and is determined to help her.
Ritsu's old middle school friend invites the band to perform at a live house on New Year's Eve. How will the evening pan out?
Heartseed grows bored with the group, takes over Iori's body, and jumps off a bridge.
Sakura wants to confess her feelings to her crush, Nozaki. Unfortunately, when she does, he thinks she is just a fan of his shojo manga.
After weeks of blissful silence, the members of the group start hearing voices, and their peace is once again shattered.
Nozaki's friend and fellow manga artist Mikoshiba pays a visit. Considering Mikoshiba is pretty much Nozaki's foil, Sakura can't figure out how or why the two are friends.
When members of the Student Council act on their desires, momentary pleasure might cause permanent damage.
Sakura learns that she and Mikoshiba aren't the only ones helping Nozaki with his mangas. Concerned with who may be cozying up to Nozaki, Sakura is on a new mission.

The quarrels between club members cause a mighty rift to form between them, until they receive some surprisingly good advice from an unlikely source; infighting between the club members begins to boil over.
Mikoshiba is invited to a mixer, but isn't sure about his social skills. Fortunately, with a little help from Nozaki and Sakura, he might be able to figure it out just enough.
Inaba is the only member of the group who doesn't seem to be truthful about her desires.
When Sakura notices that Nozaki's apartment is pristine, she panics, worried that he's trying to impress another girl. What she discovers is even more irritating.
Heartseed's warning begins to come to fruition; to avoid becoming a cautionary tale, Inaba and Iori vow to leave someone crying.
Nozaki gives Wakamatsu a gift to help him fight his insomnia, but what he doesn't tell him is that this gift may also be his worst nightmare.
Heartseed's absence allows the group to enjoy some time off; Taichi soon receives a visitor who stirs up new troubles for the group.
Koko insists that Banri should attend his high school reunion. Later on, Yana begins to connect the dots, discovering the secret of Linda and Banri's past.
Kiriyama deals with a friend and a promise; Aoki must decide who he really loves.
Banri and Linda return home for their high school reunion. In his absence, a lonely Koko decides to sneak into Banri's apartment.
Everyone pays the price for Taichi's mistake; Iori receives a call from her mother, and the team sets out to help.
Banri returns from his reunion where his friends throw him a welcome home dinner. Yana wants to start filming the Festival Club as a ploy to get closer to Linda.
At first glance, he's just the disturbed boy, and she's just the popular girl; people are more than the sum of their parts, as both Kyotaro and Anna come to discover.
Yana has begun filming for the festival club, but his plan to get closer to Linda is failing terribly. Banri struggles to give Koko the ring his mother left him.
Ichikawa starts to tolerate Yamada's presence as they find themselves alone once again in his favorite retreat, the library.
Yuko didn't have horns or a tail when she went to bed last night! Now her mom's revealing the deep dark secret their family's been hiding for generations - What's going on!?
Anna and her friends keep their guard up around the boys; it's obvious what they want, but Kyotaros is different; each brief interaction brings him and Anna closer together.
Well it's time for Yuko to murderize a magical girl - but not before she gets in some exercise and spends her allowance, of course.
Like many people his own age, Kyotaro has a tendency to overthink everything; Anna, however, has her own way of approaching life.
Lilith contacts Yuko in her dreams with vital information she must remember. After all, Yuko needs all the help she can get! Say, why is Momo helping her anyways?
The class splits into groups for a trip, and Ichikawa gets into the group with Yamada and the other girls. He begins to suffer under the guidance of Yamada's friend Sekine.
Wait a minute; there's a switch on the bottom of Yuko's ancestor statue. What happens if it's turned on? Later, Yuko needs cash fast cause she owes Momo A LOT of money!
Kyotaro wrestles with his feelings as he notices Anna's strange behavior. The library enforces a no-eating rule, and Kyotaro worries Anna won't visit anymore.
Momo finally meets Ryoko. Later, the accident-prone Yuko must carry a FRAGILE and VALUABLE laptop home with her. What could possibly go wrong?
Kyotaro finally admits to himself that he likes Anna, but wonders about her feelings for him. Kyotaro learns that Anna will be on a weekly TV program.
Yuko will need to go deeper into Momo's subconscious so she can implant the idea that will change everything! Perhaps compassion can triumph where fighting has failed.
Kyotaro gets anxious during the Parent Teacher Conference because his mother is at school, and she is talking to Anna. Later, Kyotaro gets sick and Anna visits him.
A change of fortune can only mean one thing: FOOD. Later, Yuko learns the hard way that she and Momo have vastly different definitions of "training."
Kyotaro refuses to believe that Anna could actually like him despite all the hints she has been throwing his way and the perception of those around them.
Mikan finally makes her debut, and Yuko's anxiety spikes to even higher levels! Is the magical girl here to murderize Yuko or for another reason?
Kyotaro and Anna hang out during Christmas and go pancake eating and shopping. Later, they encounter Kyotaro's sister.
Yuko and Momo finally resume their duel. In the end, there can be only one winner - who will receive the higher exam score? Later, Mikan takes Yuko to a zombie horror movie.
Distance separates Kyotaro and Anna, but they are thinking of each other; their budding relationship faces a threat; Haruya still has his eyes set on Anna.
Look out Yuko, Shion's up to something - and she won't rest until she runs her experiments! Then, can Yuko and Momo keep a secret from Ryoko?
Kyotaro didn't think his cunning plan for New Year's all the way through; Anna showed up early and his sister is trying to be his wingwoman.
Yuko's worried about Momo and dives into her dreams again to get the magical girl to open up. However, is that a good idea? Who knows what could happen this time.
Momo needs to process the shocking revelations that rocked her to the core! Perhaps Yuko can solve the dilemma by offering Momo a deal with a demon girl.
Teiichi finds himself lost in the old hallways of Seikyou Academy, and stumbles upon the school's resident ghost, Yuko.
Misaki, the iron-fisted student council president, hides a secret: she works in a maid cafe! She's discovered by the most popular guy in school; what's his price for silence?
Teiichi receives a mysterious letter that leads him to meet Kirie, who warns him of Yuko's true nature.
Misaki's secret is spreading; now the Three Idiots are onto her too! Worse, the school festival's coming, and Class 2-2's about to rebel! One single mistake could expose her!
The Paranormal Investigation Club holds a summer break training camp in the old school building to look into another ghost story.
It's Little Sister Day at the cafe. Misaki can't get into the role, but a severe scolding by Honoka makes her turn her act around. Misaki nails the parté until Takumi arrives.

Yuko tells Teiichi to keep his distance from her after an unfortunate incident; Kirie thinks that Yuko is sending her painful memories to her shadow self.
